title: Export Record
description: v1 contract (task M5-T125, directive D-090 Wave 0; derived lane plan docs/lanes/PARALLEL_BUILD_PLAN.md section 5) for ONE historical export - a PDF report, Excel calculation file or DXF (plan docs/PRODUCT_PLAN_CURRENT_2026-09-28.md section 3 step 7, section 9 'Historical exports'; task M1-19). It records the export's inputs (the study as it stood, with its digest), the sources, the rule versions and the results (snapshot reference plus canonical digest). Reopening it is read-only history (read_only is always true), and 'Start a new study from this' copies INPUTS ONLY (restore_policy is always 'copy_inputs_only'): facts are re-fetched and results recalculated, with the differences listed; nothing imported becomes a current fact or result.

contract_version.description: CLOSED enum of published export_record contract versions. 1.0.0 = M5-T125 initial shape (D-090 Wave 0). New versions are admitted only by an accepted contract task that appends to this enum.

format.description: The three export files (plan section 3 step 7). DWG is not produced (native-DWG libraries stay an owner licensing decision).

inputs.description: The inputs as they stood at export: the whole study (lots, selection, site facts with their sources, options). This is the ONLY part 'Start a new study from this' copies.

sources.description: Every source behind the exported values (dataset, version, date, query or document), in the site_fact source shape.

rule_versions.description: Every rule table version the exported results used.

results.description: The results as exported, by reference and digest. Historical results are shown as history only and never become current results.

results_digest.description: canonical-json-1 digest of the exported results document.

snapshot_ref.description: Storage reference of the frozen results snapshot.

read_only.description: Always true: reopening an export shows it read-only, as history (plan section 9).

restore_policy.description: Always 'copy_inputs_only': a new study copies inputs only; facts are re-fetched and results recalculated, with the differences listed (plan section 9).

_expected_failure.description: FIXTURE-ONLY annotation stating the intended defect of an invalid fixture (packages/contracts README convention). Producers NEVER emit this key.
